name: Check HTTPS service link
command: set -u; for url in https://upload-assistant.destinyhdd.box.ca/api/health https://destiny.whatbox.ca/api/health http://upload-assistant.destinyhdd.box.ca/api/health; do echo "$url"; curl -4 -k -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 15 "$url" || true; done
description: Test the likely migrated HTTPS reverse-proxy links without exposing any credentials.
